sources.name: GlobalSurnames — Most Common Slovak Surnames (Slovakia)
sources.population: Slovakia, surname incidence estimates; no official annual register claimed
sources.method: Country-coded surname attestations (source ranks used only to find a research sample, not weights). Selected entries case-normalized and de-duplicated for accent-insensitive equivalents; all preserved forms attested.
sources.license: Source data redistribution/license not confirmed; research-only pending approval
sources.limitations: The online compiled ranking has some omissions and intersperses feminine -ová forms, both allowed as registered surnames.

sources.name: Forebears — Most Common Surnames in Slovakia (2014)
sources.method: Cross-check national presence and add Kováč and Lukáč independently attested there; no rank/frequency retained

sources.name: Forebears Slovakia Top 1,000 surname list archived in p-svacha/ProceduralTextGeneration
sources.method: Country-specific 2014 surname forms, not source incidence weights; original 500 retained; only unmatched Latin forms appended
sources.population: Slovak residents — Forebears 2014 estimates; not government birth registry
sources.license: Compiled source: source redistribution rights not yet established

sources.name: Damegender Slovakia surnames — biographical records, source-published forms
sources.method: Country-coded Slovak biographical surnames; discard occurrence numbers and non-Latin values; no weights stored
sources.population: Selected biographical subjects, nonrepresentative of general Slovak resident population
sources.license: Check upstream Damegender data attribution and Wikidata (CC0) provenance; reuse rights require review

sources.name: Mock::Person::SK — Slovak surname examples from family genealogy
sources.source_description: Module README identifies family-genealogy surname source, including faskofamily.com; not official prevalence figures
sources.method: Only entries from @last_male surname array; do not transform surname morphology or generate new variants
sources.license: BSD-style; original family-data provenance and redistribution should be reviewed

sources.name: Pointblank — Slovakia country-specific surname dataset
sources.method: Read only last_names category in Slovak locale; ignore probability/frequency tiers
sources.license: Inspect upstream dataset licensing before reuse

sources.name: GaaraLi/gem_1 — Slovak faker locale surname dictionaries
sources.method: Read explicitly listed man_last_name and woman_last_name values only; no synthetic generation of -ová variants
sources.license: Check Ruby project and dataset-specific attribution; no official census confirmation

sources.name: mykola-telychko/slavic-names — Slovak source surname section only
sources.method: Select surnames-only section after the first 152 given names; no given-name or constructed-name values imported
sources.license: Confirm upstream data licensing; compilation not a population register
